name: app.smartclip/smartclip-mcp
title: SmartClip MCP
description: Read logged-in Chrome tabs as Markdown and clip to 16 note apps via Local Bridge Hub.

environmentVariables.name: SMARTCLIP_MCP_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared session token for authenticating the SmartClip Chrome extension handshake.

environmentVariables.name: SMARTCLIP_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated exact WebSocket Origin allowlist overriding the default browser-extension origin policy.
